notes.title: Minor demo update!
notes.content:
Happy 2025!

We pushed an update to the demo, so please take a look! We got a lot of feedback since our demo launch last month that we greatly appreciate. We hope this update will allow more players to complete the demo. Some notable changes:

[list]
[*] Updated UIs (Health, fonts, enemy full damage shown on hover)
[*] Minor rebalancing for cards, relics and enemies
[*] "Demo" starter deck with "Knight's Pledge" and some cards starting at level 2. We want players to see more of the fun parts of this game.
[*] Bug squashing!
[/list]

We're also working on a bigger visual update that we hope to reveal later this year. Cheers!
